newsitem.title: USA: Rofin-Sinar preliminary Q3 sales $31.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Rofin-Sinar preliminary Q3 sales $31.2 mln.

text.p: Rofin-Sinar Technologies Inc said Wednesday preliminary results for the third quarter ended June 30 indicate its sales rose 5.4 percent from a year ago to $31.2 million.
The rise was led by an 8.3 percent increase in European and Asian sales of its laser products, it said. North American sales remained flat.
Order entry for the third quarter rose 24.7 percent from a year ago to $31.3 million, it said. The company's June 30 order backlog was $34.3 million.
